county_counts.name: Presidio
county_counts.scope: Source county labels for records within the Terlingua 50-mile study circle; partial county coverage.

coverage_note: Partial coverage: the well-record snapshot is limited to Texas records within 50 miles of Terlingua Ghost Town, crossing parts of Brewster and Presidio counties. The circle also reaches Mexico, where this collection has no well-record coverage. Highlighted counties are navigation areas, not a claim of complete county research.
freshness_note: Published snapshot from 2026-10-23. No live feed, automated monitoring, or currently tested connector is claimed by this website.
coverage_meaning: Map colors describe information indexed by Water Atlas, not water availability, water quality, drilling prospects, ownership, or access rights.
